name: aip
description: Architecture-aware development with AIP: plan an event or messaging-contract change from evidence-qualified architecture knowledge (Pitstop demo client material).

aip_mcp_url.title: AIP MCP URL
aip_mcp_url.description: The AIP MCP endpoint run.sh prints (default: the local demo). For an installed plugin set the hosted URL here; with --plugin-dir the AIP_MCP_URL environment variable overrides it.

aip_token.title: AIP token
aip_token.description: Access token of a token-gated AIP instance (leave empty for the local demo). Claude Code stores it outside the normal settings file; on Linux it was observed in a mode-600 credentials file, other platforms are not verified. With --plugin-dir the AIP_MCP_TOKEN environment variable overrides it.
